item.title: Version 1.1.27
item.description: What’s New 1.Invalid server connections are now blocked 2.Devices with security updates are now supported 3.OS-based automatic screenshots are disabled 4.Sessions are terminated after completion 5.One-time MFA has been implemented 6.Users are automatically logged out after 30 minutes of inactivity 7.Screen access is restricted based on user permissions 8.Addressed critical code risks to improve security, stability, and performance 9.Added network-based filtering with All Networks, Apply, and Clear options
